claims.text: Arrival is established under POL-NS-02 only where the trace holds at least three consecutive fixes inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius, each reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better. Not one of the eight fixes in EV-GPS-00901 reports any accuracy figure at all, so none of them is measurable under that filter: the derived qualifying_fix_count is 0 and the longest qualifying run is 0.0 seconds. POL-NS-02 says in terms that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the fifteen minutes before cancellation, the driver never arrived and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. I disclose that this artifact is impaired - weight_multiplier 0.6, issue codes LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD - and the impairment does not help the charge, because an accuracy-less fix is evidence of neither presence nor absence under POL-NS-02. I do not assert the driver was physically elsewhere; I say only that no admissible fix establishes that he arrived.

The effective in-geofence dwell on this record is 0 seconds against the free waiting period of 300 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec 300, and the STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec of 300). The derived shortfall is 300.0 seconds, with run_count 0 and longest_run_sec 0.0. POL-NS-06 makes the cancellation fee not chargeable on that shortfall and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages. The ledger EV-FARE-00901 shows the $5.00 fee charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the money is still with the platform rather than returned. Disclosed impairments: EV-GPS-00901 at 0.6 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD) and EV-FARE-00901 at 0.75 (PARTIAL_RECORD); the shortfall arithmetic is read from the derived block of the trace and the fee figure reconciles with the platform policy in force.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup: EV-ADVIS-00901-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the derived arrival block records limb (i) of POL-NS-06 as unavailable for want of an advisory that is present and populated. There is therefore no route by which separate in-geofence intervals could be summed for this driver: he needed one continuous qualifying hold of 300 seconds, and the longest qualifying run the trace yields is 0.0 seconds. I cite the absence itself, as the rules permit, and I disclose that the trace the dwell is measured from is impaired at 0.6 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD).

POL-NS-12 makes the platform's arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) and for POL-GEN-02(2), and for nothing else. Even taken at its highest it does not reach POL-NS-06, whose shortfall is computed under POL-NS-02 and corrected only under POL-NS-05, so it cannot convert a measured qualifying dwell of 0 seconds into the 300 seconds the fee needs. Nor does the arrival event itself supply the missing measurement: its 'within 10m' figure is the platform's own distance claim, not a reported horizontal accuracy, and the trip record's own pre-pass records that no fix on this trace is measurable under POL-NS-02. EV-GPS-00901 is impaired at 0.6 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD); the point survives because it is a point about which clause computes the dwell, not a measurement of position.

EV-GPS-00901 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b), not merely for admissibility: the waiting window holds four fixes, fewer than the six that limb (b) requires, and its sampling gaps of 180 and 240 seconds exceed the 120 second threshold. The only measurement this record offers of the driver's in-geofence dwell is that artifact, at weight 0.6. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence in a finding that rests on it cannot exceed 0.6, below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, which engages POL-NS-09(a); and because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under limb (b) of POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09(e) is engaged as well. An escalated fee is held rather than collected, which is the least the rider should have where the dwell cannot be measured. I rest this on the fix count and the gaps, not on the absent rider track, which POL-NS-11 makes neutral.

No rider track was supplied and the derived rider_presence block is unavailable, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be run. POL-NS-11 makes that limb UNDECIDABLE and neutral: the Judge must say the test could not be run rather than infer the rider was elsewhere, and the gap does not impair the driver-side arrival or dwell evidence or lower any confidence cap on it. The rider's absence from the trace is not evidence that she was absent from the pickup point, and the platform cannot fill that gap with her silence. EV-GPS-00901 is impaired at 0.6 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD), and I disclose that on the face of this claim.

The chat log holds six entries and every one of them is from the driver or the system; the rider sent nothing in the waiting window. POL-NS-04 limb (a) therefore fails on this record, and I do not rely on that clause to exonerate the rider. I record the concession rather than stretch the point, and it leaves the arrival and dwell tests above untouched, because those turn on the driver's own evidence rather than on the rider's.

The dispute is rider-filed and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION outcome would leave the $5.00 no-show charge on the rider: NO_ACTION preserves the present payment state and is party-relative. The outcomes that take the disputed charge off the rider are a refund on the waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06, or the hold that an escalation imposes while the dwell measurement is unresolved. EV-FARE-00901 is impaired at 0.75 (PARTIAL_RECORD) and EV-GPS-00901 at 0.6 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD); the payment state and the refund figure are stated on the face of the ledger, so the point survives the discount.

claims.text: The platform's own record establishes arrival without any help from the exported trace. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO, and the events carry the platform's measured arrival — 'Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.' at 08:43:00 — followed by rider_notified at 08:43:05 and wait_timer_started at 08:43:10. Under POL-NS-12 those PLATFORM_TELEMETRY events are a carrier independent of the exported gps_trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c): arrival is established at 08:43:00 and the free waiting period is established as served when wait_timer_expired fired at 08:48:10.

The trip_record terminates the trip at 08:51:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and records no boarding: the interval from the 08:43:00 arrival to the 08:51:00 termination is 480 seconds, which is at or above both the free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, 300 s) and the no-show threshold in force (platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec, 480 s). POL-NS-01 limbs (c) and (d) are therefore carried, and the reason code is one of the three limb (d) recognises.

There is no false-arrival case to answer. The marker was auto-confirmed from the platform's own full-resolution measurement at 10 m from the pin and 0 km/h, not from a driver button press, and no fix in the exported trace can contradict it: the export is IMPAIRED (EV-GPS-00901, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and not one of its fixes reports a horizontal accuracy, so no fix in it is admissible to affirmatively place the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker timestamp. POL-NS-05 is not engaged and no recomputation of the waiting clock is triggered.

The export's zero qualifying-fix count cannot be read as the driver's absence. No fix in EV-GPS-00901 (IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) reports any horizontal accuracy, and POL-NS-02, read with the integrity block's accuracy_missing_treatment of UNKNOWN, makes an accuracy-less fix evidence of neither presence nor absence. derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count of 0 is the accuracy filter doing its work on this export, not a measurement that the driver was elsewhere at 08:43:00.

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to refund. derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.shortfall_sec of 300 s is computed from the same accuracy-less, impaired export (EV-GPS-00901, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD), whereas POL-NS-12 establishes the dwell as served from the platform's own wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events in trip_record. No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed for the driver's case, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00901-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0) is not relied on by this claim, directly or by assertion.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider because its limb (a) has nothing behind it. The chat log's six entries are five from the driver and one from the system, and not one locating or coordinating message was sent by the rider during the waiting window: no position, no entrance, no block or bay identifier, no request for the driver's position, no statement that the vehicle could not be seen.

Even if a limb (a) message existed, limb (b) of POL-NS-04 fails. trip_record.in_app_calls records that the driver placed an in-app voice call to the rider at 08:47:05 (CALL-00901-001, rang 22 seconds, unanswered) before terminating the trip at 08:51:00, and the chat log carries the same call as MSG-00901-003. The driver both messaged and called; the rider answered neither.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 cannot be run at all on this record: the export carries no rider track (derived.rider_presence.available is false, with the reason that the source trace carries no rider track). On POL-NS-11 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on it; and notwithstanding POL-NS-08(b), the missing rider track is not the evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell and does not lower the confidence cap on a finding that rests on the driver's track. The rider was not shown to be elsewhere; the test simply could not be run.

No wrong-entrance case is reached, so nothing in POL-NS-03 displaces the fee or the driver's payout. POL-NS-03 fires only where the stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m, and the platform's own measurement places the driver 10 m from the pin at 0 km/h. In any event its limb (i) cannot be turned against the driver, because the chat log contains no rider statement of any entrance, block, tower or bay — the rider named no sub-location in the only communication channel that can carry one.

The driver's payout follows from the fee standing. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee in force for this trip — 0.8 x the 5.00 read from trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd per fee_schedule.resolution_rule — which the fare ledger's own derived money block computes as driver_compensation 4.00 (EV-FARE-00901, IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD). The anti-farming check cannot withhold it: the conjunctive test is read from driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, which is null on this record, so the first limb ('4 or more') is not met and the check is undecidable here rather than tripped.

There is no fare defect that could discount the fee. The fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line is 5.00 and coincides with the net amount the fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip from trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged (EV-FARE-00901, IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD; the reconciliation itself rests on EV-TRIP-00901 at weight 1.0).

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met, so this case is decidable and must not be sent to review. (b): no admissible artifact contradicts the arrival or the dwell — the export is unmeasurable, not contradictory; (c): rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both null, so the '2 or more' limb is not met; (d): rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is null and a null is not '3 or more', and the rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1 is not the field that limb reads; (e): the deciding facts for the fee rest on EV-TRIP-00901 at weight 1.0, which POL-NS-12 makes an independent carrier, so they are not carried solely by an artifact impaired under limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08.

Any attempt to build a finding on the rider's prior_no_show_flags of 1 is barred on the same footing as an uncited claim. POL-GEN-01 makes that field CONTEXT ONLY: it is a lifetime counter, it is a deliberate near-synonym trap for rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, and it is that trailing-window field — which is null here — that POL-NS-09(d) names and that no one may substitute for.

The confidence cap does not approach the 0.70 floor. The deciding facts — arrival, dwell served and termination for a rider no-show — are carried by EV-TRIP-00901 and EV-CHAT-00901, both at weight 1.0, so on POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is 1.0. The only impaired artifacts on the driver's side of the ledger are the export (EV-GPS-00901, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and the fare ledger (EV-FARE-00901, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD), and both are disclosed in these claims, with their issue codes, rather than presented as clean.

The outcome for this rider-filed dispute is NO_ACTION on the fee together with a driver payout. The ledger shows the 5.00 as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 (EV-FARE-00901, IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD), so leaving the present state as it is leaves the charge in place and the rider's claim unsupported. Because the verified no-show also produces a driver payment, the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and under POL-GEN-03 its amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd of 4.00 — it is not a refund to the filing party and is not netted against the fee.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider (R-7823): your $5.00 no-show cancellation fee is upheld and stands charged, and $4.00 of it is paid to the driver. To the driver (D-2398): your fee stands and your payout is confirmed at $4.00.

What decides the case. Trip TRIP-2026-09945 was booked 08:30, the driver assigned 08:30:15, and the platform recorded its own arrival measurement at 08:43:00 — 'Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.' — because trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO. The platform then notified the rider at 08:43:05, started the free 5-minute wait timer at 08:43:10, called the rider in-app at 08:47:05 (22 s, unanswered), marked the free wait expired at 08:48:10, and terminated the trip at 08:51:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, charging the $5.00 fee (EV-TRIP-00901). POL-NS-12 applies: with a GPS_AUTO marker, the platform's own arrival event (distance and speed) plus wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired are its full-resolution measurement and an independent carrier for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) — arrival is established at 08:43:00, and the free waiting period is established as served at 08:48:10. No admissible fix places the driver outside the arrival radius or moving at 15 km/h, so the POL-NS-12 exception and POL-NS-05 do not fire. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) an 'arrived' event exists; (b) arrival is established from the platform's own measurement; (c) the dwell from 08:43:10 to 08:48:10 is the 300 s platform_policy.free_wait_sec requires, and the 08:51:00 cancellation is 480 s after arrival, meeting platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec of 480 s; (d) no boarding was recorded and the driver terminated with RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout.

The rider's arguments, answered. The rider's case rests on the exported trace EV-GPS-00901, which is impaired (weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and reports no horizontal accuracy on any of its eight fixes. The rider argues that under POL-NS-02 no qualifying in-radius fix exists, so the driver never arrived and limb (b) fails, and that under POL-NS-06 the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the required 300 s, so the fee must be fully refunded. Both are rejected. POL-NS-12 is directed at exactly this situation: a sparse or accuracy-less export does not impair the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events, which establish arrival and the waiting period served. The derived qualifying_fix_count of 0 and accumulated_dwell of 0 s are the 25 m accuracy filter operating on an export that reports no accuracy at all, not measurements that the driver was elsewhere; under POL-NS-02 an accuracy-less fix is evidence of neither presence nor absence. There is no waiting-period shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund. The rider's point that POL-NS-12 does not reach POL-NS-06 is not accepted: POL-NS-12 establishes the free waiting period as served for POL-NS-01 limb (c), and POL-NS-06's shortfall test is measured against that period, so it finds nothing to refund. The rider is correct that the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00901-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable, but it decides nothing because there is no shortfall to accumulate across. The rider is also correct that no rider track was supplied, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and neutral under POL-NS-11 rather than adverse — and that too decides nothing, because the fee rests on the driver's evidence. The rider is right that the chat log EV-CHAT-00901 holds no rider message (all six entries are the driver's or the system's) so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails and cannot exonerate the rider; the driver's in-app call and messages defeat limb (b) in any event.

The driver's case, answered. I accept that the fee stands and that POL-NS-07 fixes the payout: 80 percent of the $5.00 fee in force (read from trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd as fee_schedule.resolution_rule directs) is $4.00, which the fare ledger's derived money block also computes (EV-FARE-00901, impaired, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD). The anti-farming check does not withhold it: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is null, so the '4 or more' limb is not met and the check is undecidable rather than tripped. POL-NS-04 limb (a) therefore fails on this record, and I do not rely on that clause to exonerate the rider. I record the concession rather than stretch the point, and it leaves the arrival and dwell tests above untouched, because those turn on the driver's own evidence rather than on the rider's.

The dispute is rider-filed and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION outcome would leave the $5.00 no-show charge on the rider: NO_ACTION preserves the present payment state and is party-relative. The outcomes that take the disputed charge off the rider are a refund on the waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06, or the hold that an escalation imposes while the dwell measurement is unresolved. EV-FARE-00901 is impaired at 0.75 (PARTIAL_RECORD) and EV-GPS-00901 at 0.6 (LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD); the payment state and the refund figure are stated on the face of the ledger, so the point survives the discount.

The platform's own record establishes arrival without any help from the exported trace. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO, and the events carry the platform's measured arrival — 'Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.' at 08:43:00 — followed by rider_notified at 08:43:05 and wait_timer_started at 08:43:10. Under POL-NS-12 those PLATFORM_TELEMETRY events are a carrier independent of the exported gps_trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c): arrival is established at 08:43:00 and the free waiting period is established as served when wait_timer_expired fired at 08:48:10.

The trip_record terminates the trip at 08:51:00 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and records no boarding: the interval from the 08:43:00 arrival to the 08:51:00 termination is 480 seconds, which is at or above both the free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, 300 s) and the no-show threshold in force (platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec, 480 s). POL-NS-01 limbs (c) and (d) are therefore carried, and the reason code is one of the three limb (d) recognises.

There is no false-arrival case to answer. The marker was auto-confirmed from the platform's own full-resolution measurement at 10 m from the pin and 0 km/h, not from a driver button press, and no fix in the exported trace can contradict it: the export is IMPAIRED (EV-GPS-00901, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and not one of its fixes reports a horizontal accuracy, so no fix in it is admissible to affirmatively place the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more at the marker timestamp. POL-NS-05 is not engaged and no recomputation of the waiting clock is triggered.

The export's zero qualifying-fix count cannot be read as the driver's absence. No fix in EV-GPS-00901 (IMPAIRED, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) reports any horizontal accuracy, and POL-NS-02, read with the integrity block's accuracy_missing_treatment of UNKNOWN, makes an accuracy-less fix evidence of neither presence nor absence. derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count of 0 is the accuracy filter doing its work on this export, not a measurement that the driver was elsewhere at 08:43:00.

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so POL-NS-06 has nothing to refund. derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.shortfall_sec of 300 s is computed from the same accuracy-less, impaired export (EV-GPS-00901, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD), whereas POL-NS-12 establishes the dwell as served from the platform's own wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired events in trip_record. No accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed for the driver's case, and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00901-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0) is not relied on by this claim, directly or by assertion.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider because its limb (a) has nothing behind it. The chat log's six entries are five from the driver and one from the system, and not one locating or coordinating message was sent by the rider during the waiting window: no position, no entrance, no block or bay identifier, no request for the driver's position, no statement that the vehicle could not be seen.

Even if a limb (a) message existed, limb (b) of POL-NS-04 fails. trip_record.in_app_calls records that the driver placed an in-app voice call to the rider at 08:47:05 (CALL-00901-001, rang 22 seconds, unanswered) before terminating the trip at 08:51:00, and the chat log carries the same call as MSG-00901-003. The driver both messaged and called; the rider answered neither.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 cannot be run at all on this record: the export carries no rider track (derived.rider_presence.available is false, with the reason that the source trace carries no rider track). On POL-NS-11 limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on it; and notwithstanding POL-NS-08(b), the missing rider track is not the evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell and does not lower the confidence cap on a finding that rests on the driver's track. The rider was not shown to be elsewhere; the test simply could not be run.

ledger.claim: No wrong-entrance case is reached, so nothing in POL-NS-03 displaces the fee or the driver's payout. POL-NS-03 fires only where the stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m, and the platform's own measurement places the driver 10 m from the pin at 0 km/h. In any event its limb (i) cannot be turned against the driver, because the chat log contains no rider statement of any entrance, block, tower or bay — the rider named no sub-location in the only communication channel that can carry one.

The driver's payout follows from the fee standing. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee in force for this trip — 0.8 x the 5.00 read from trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd per fee_schedule.resolution_rule — which the fare ledger's own derived money block computes as driver_compensation 4.00 (EV-FARE-00901, IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD). The anti-farming check cannot withhold it: the conjunctive test is read from driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, which is null on this record, so the first limb ('4 or more') is not met and the check is undecidable here rather than tripped.

There is no fare defect that could discount the fee. The fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line is 5.00 and coincides with the net amount the fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip from trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged (EV-FARE-00901, IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD; the reconciliation itself rests on EV-TRIP-00901 at weight 1.0).

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met, so this case is decidable and must not be sent to review. (b): no admissible artifact contradicts the arrival or the dwell — the export is unmeasurable, not contradictory; (c): rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both null, so the '2 or more' limb is not met; (d): rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is null and a null is not '3 or more', and the rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 1 is not the field that limb reads; (e): the deciding facts for the fee rest on EV-TRIP-00901 at weight 1.0, which POL-NS-12 makes an independent carrier, so they are not carried solely by an artifact impaired under limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08.

ledger.claim: Any attempt to build a finding on the rider's prior_no_show_flags of 1 is barred on the same footing as an uncited claim. POL-GEN-01 makes that field CONTEXT ONLY: it is a lifetime counter, it is a deliberate near-synonym trap for rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, and it is that trailing-window field — which is null here — that POL-NS-09(d) names and that no one may substitute for.

ledger.claim: The confidence cap does not approach the 0.70 floor. The deciding facts — arrival, dwell served and termination for a rider no-show — are carried by EV-TRIP-00901 and EV-CHAT-00901, both at weight 1.0, so on POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is 1.0. The only impaired artifacts on the driver's side of the ledger are the export (EV-GPS-00901, weight 0.6, issues LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD) and the fare ledger (EV-FARE-00901, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD), and both are disclosed in these claims, with their issue codes, rather than presented as clean.

The outcome for this rider-filed dispute is NO_ACTION on the fee together with a driver payout. The ledger shows the 5.00 as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 (EV-FARE-00901, IMPAIRED, weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD), so leaving the present state as it is leaves the charge in place and the rider's claim unsupported. Because the verified no-show also produces a driver payment, the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and under POL-GEN-03 its amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd of 4.00 — it is not a refund to the filing party and is not netted against the fee.
